channel.title: Cheakstar Blog
channel.description: Practical cybersecurity articles from Cheakstar Private Limited, Jaipur — simple, honest guides for beginners and small businesses.

item.title: Password Habits That Actually Work (and Take Ten Minutes)
item.description: Forget complicated rules. Three password habits, set up in ten minutes, prevent most account takeovers.

item.title: Software Updates: The Security Habit Hiding in Plain Sight
item.description: Most real attacks use flaws that were already fixed. A beginner-friendly guide to updates: what they patch, what to switch on, and what to ignore.

item.title: How to Spot a Phishing Message in Under a Minute
item.description: Five calm checks that expose most phishing messages - and the one habit that defeats the rest.

item.title: Learning Cybersecurity From Zero: A Roadmap Without the Noise
item.description: A staged roadmap for cybersecurity beginners: what to learn first, what to skip for now, and how to know you are progressing.

item.title: Password Habits, Part Two: The Cleanup Most People Skip
item.description: Your passwords are unique and two-factor is on. Now finish the job: old accounts, recovery paths and backup codes, cleaned up in one sitting.

item.title: What Is API Security? A Beginner's Plain-English Guide
item.description: APIs run the modern internet - and fail in simple, repeated ways. A beginner-friendly tour of what API security means and why it matters.

item.title: What Is Bug Bounty? A Beginner's Honest Starting Guide
item.description: Bug bounty explained plainly: what it is, what it is not, and the honest order in which a beginner should learn it.

item.title: Why Permission Comes First in Hacking - Always
item.description: The legal and ethical line that separates security research from crime, explained for beginners - and why professionals guard it fiercely.

item.title: Your Browser Is a Vault: Simple Ways to Keep It Locked
item.description: You live inside your browser - email, banking, work and study. Five plain habits that keep the most-used app on your devices properly secured.

item.title: The Six-Digit Code Scam: How Messaging Accounts Get Stolen
item.description: A friend - or a stranger - asks for a six-digit code that just arrived on your phone. Handing it over hands over your account. How the trick works and the one rule that defeats it.
